responsibility: Implements LRA’s hard-register assignment subpass. It builds and prioritizes reload, inheritance, split, and ordinary pseudos; forms copy-connected threads to improve co-assignment; chooses hard registers using availability, target register priorities, and leveling heuristics; spills competing pseudos when necessary; and detects assignment failure cases that may require hard-register live-range splitting or diagnostics for impossible asm constraints. This file performs assignment only and leaves RTL rewriting to other LRA subpasses.
